sentences.text: On the other hand the counsel for the State has opposed the bail application and submitted that the FSL report has come positive and the age of the prosecutrix as per the recorded date of birth is 17 years.

Considering the aforesaid since the applicant is an under trial accused is in jail since 27.02.2022,
prosecutrix has been examined and not supported the case of prosecution, her date of birth is seriously disputed, I am inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance on the dates given by it.

I t is further directed that the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3)
of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

However, the Superintendent of Police, Damoh and Collector Damoh are directed that the compensation, if any, is paid to the prosecutrix under any of the schemes sponsored by the Central Government or the State Government, the same shall be recovered from the prosecutrix.
The trial Court is also directed that the amount, if any, is paid towards compensation to the prosecutrix treating her to be a victim, the said amount be recovered from her.
Let a copy of this order be forwarded to the S.P. Damoh and Collector Damoh for information and necessary compliance.

(SANJAY DWIVEDI) JUDGE ac/-
